item.title: Open PDF Editor 0.7.0
item.description: Editing like a word processor. Click anywhere in a page's text and a cursor appears: type, delete, select across lines and press Return, and the paragraph re-wraps in its box, keeping its font where the PDF has the letters. The new formatting bar and Format menu change the font, size, bold, italic, underline (⌘B, ⌘I, ⌘U), colour and alignment, and Add Text puts a new text box anywhere. Start with the Edit button in the toolbar, Edit › Edit Content (⌥⌘E), or Edit Text when you right-click text. Lines you don't change stay exactly as they were; drag the grip on a box's right to change the width it wraps at; and a box that runs into the text below says so, since text doesn't flow from one paragraph to the next.
